s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic hand dermatitis with atopic background
salient_findings: Positive patch testing reactions to multiple allergens
Long-standing history of atopic diseases including asthma and rhinitis
key_facts: 18 years history of chronic hand eczema
Onset of hand eczema occurred in early childhood
Medical history includes asthma and rhinitis
Positive family history for atopy
Limited contact with irritants
HECSI score was 244 of 360 at initial presentation
Positive patch testing reactions to nickel, cobalt, and other allergens
Hand eczema rated as 'very severe' according to validated photographic guide

shortlist.label: Atopic dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: 18 years history of chronic hand eczema with onset in early childhood and positive family history for atopy

shortlist.label: Allergic contact dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive patch testing reactions to nickel, cobalt, and other allergens

shortlist.label: Dyshidrotic eczema
shortlist.why_kept: Very severe hand eczema with HECSI score of 244 and positive reactions to allergens

raw.rationale: The patient's history of chronic hand eczema since childhood, combined with a medical history of asthma and rhinitis and a positive family history for atopy, strongly supports atopic dermatitis as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Allergic contact dermatitis
rejected.why: While the patient has positive patch testing reactions, the onset of hand eczema in early childhood and the presence of atopic conditions suggest a more intrinsic atopic component.

rejected.label: Dyshidrotic eczema
rejected.why: Dyshidrotic eczema typically presents with vesicular lesions on the palms and soles, which is not explicitly mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Irritant contact dermatitis
rejected.why: The patient had limited contact with irritants, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Nummular dermatitis
rejected.why: Nummular dermatitis typically presents with coin-shaped patches, which does not match the description of the patient's very severe chronic hand eczema.
